text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N11","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE HARDENED UPTO 32-35 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies hardening to 32-35 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be applied (e.g., before or after finish machining). This matters because hardening after final machining can distort tight-tolerance features like the ⌀12 H7 hole (D4), while hardening before requires subsequent grinding. The designer should add a clear stage instruction such as 'HARDEN BEFORE FINAL MACHINING' or 'HARDEN AFTER ROUGH MACHINING, THEN GRIND.'.","recommended_correction":"Update N11 to specify the manufacturing stage at which the 32-35 HRC hardening applies."},{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"# MATÉRIEL : EN24"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"# FINITION :  I.Z.B.P. Duplicated notes copied from a bilingual template clutter the drawing and risk confusion if one language version is updated without the other. The designer should remove the redundant French notes unless a bilingual release is explicitly required by the document control standard.","recommended_correction":"Remove notes N5, N6, N7, and N8, or confirm that bilingual duplication is required and ensure both sets remain synchronized."}]}
